blocking_findings.summary: T2-AC1: S4 post-run raise: a run that ends in error but reported usage raises the mark through raiseProviderSessionContextHighWaterMark with the model-visible input tokens T1 computes; a run that reported no usage does not call the operation at all (not with zero, not with undefined).

non_blocking_findings.summary: Do not charge a fresh run's usage to the concurrently refreshed session (apps/core/src/runtime/group-agent-runner-context-ceiling.ts:260): When a fingerprint retirement loses its fence, recovery passes `restoreResumeIdentifiers: false`, so the subsequent run deliberately starts without a resume ID and cannot persist its replacement.
